title: General fourth-chaos repair requires cancellation of the exact divergent negative-form direction

projection_criterion.metric: Use the Hilbert inner product <x,y>_(-1)=<A^(-1/2)x,A^(-1/2)y> with A=H_0+1
projection_criterion.decomposition: For Z_N=P_4 C_N Omega write Z_N=alpha_N W_N+Z_N^perp with Z_N^perp orthogonal to W_N in the negative-form metric
projection_criterion.criterion: Uniform boundedness is equivalent to g+alpha_N=O(1/||A^(-1/2)W_N||) and ||A^(-1/2)Z_N^perp||=O(1)
projection_criterion.consequence: Every successful fourth-chaos counterterm must cancel the exact divergent direction while controlling its orthogonal remainder
projection_criterion.ceiling: This necessary vacuum-column criterion does not prove semiboundedness, all-sector control, convergence, locality or a source Hamiltonian
